verdict.rationale: Gusto documents its own programmatic surfaces: an MCP server, a one-command CLI, and a Multi-Client MCP for firms. Through these, agents can ask payroll and team questions, prep payroll, and generate reports. That is only a subset of the UI's capabilities, and final changes still route through owner approval, so nothing shows the API matches the UI. Missing for 10: any documented claim or evidence that the API, MCP or CLI covers the full UI feature set (benefits, compliance, formation, contractors, HR documents), public API reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage depth.
